title: More ways to make and reshape music
summary:
Audio had the loudest day: reference-guided music, Stable Audio 2.5, sound effects, and multilingual speech joined quieter catalog and account fixes.

A Quest contribution upgraded `elevenmusic` to music_v2, adding reference-audio conditioning, composition plans, and tracks that can be saved for later inpainting. Another added Stable Audio 2.5 for WAV music generation with duration, step, and seed controls. Enter’s model table gained a Stability AI icon.

ElevenLabs Sound Effects v2 adds text-to-sound-effect generation with duration, looping, and prompt-influence controls. Multilingual v2 adds text-to-speech in 29 languages, and the TTS input limit rose from 4,096 to 10,000 characters.

Catalog updates added RoleChar and a SpiritPet World feature overview, refreshed the Greenhouse listings and metrics, and removed a dead app link. The regenerated Greenhouse count reached 812 apps.

highlights.title: Reference-guided music
highlights.text: `elevenmusic` now uses music_v2. Use reference audio for style conditioning, work with composition plans, or save a generated track for later inpainting. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elevenmusic).

highlights.title: Stable Audio 2.5
highlights.text: Generate WAV music with `stable-audio-2.5`, with controls for duration, steps, and seed. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=stable-audio-2.5).

highlights.title: Text-to-sound effects
highlights.text: Generate MP3 sound effects with `eleven-sfx`. Set a duration from 0.5 to 30 seconds, enable looping, or adjust `prompt_influence`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=eleven-sfx).

highlights.title: Speech in 29 languages
highlights.text: Use `eleven-multilingual-v2` for text-to-speech in 29 languages through the existing speech API. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=eleven-multilingual-v2).

highlights.title: Longer text-to-speech input
highlights.text: TTS requests now accept up to 10,000 characters, up from 4,096. Fewer splits for longer passages. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
